Financial software company Intuit Inc. today announced that it has agreed to sell its Mailchimp email marketing business to Italian technology holding company Bending Spoons S.p.A. for about $3.68 billion. Coming five years after Intuit agreed to acquire Mailchimp for $12 billion, the sale price is less than a third of what the company paid. […]
